name: hooks-monorepo

scripts.check: npm run build:a && npm run test:a && npm run build:b && npm run test:b
scripts.preview:a: npm run build -w app-a && npm run preview -w app-a
scripts.preview:b: npm run build -w app-b && npm run preview -w app-b

//: Root tooling (e.g. Storybook) pins React 18, so npm hoists react@18.3.1 to <root>/node_modules.
